class_prompts.vine_plant: cultivated grapevine plant in a vineyard row, including woody grapevine trunk, cordon, canes, and branches; exclude trees, hedges, bushes, wall vegetation, grass, and wooden posts
class_prompts.vine_trunk: bare woody grapevine trunk, cordon, cane, and brown grapevine branches attached to a grapevine; exclude wooden vineyard posts, stakes, tree trunks, and stone walls
class_prompts.wooden_post: vertical wooden vineyard support post or stake, weathered wood, not grapevine trunk
class_prompts.ground: bare soil ground in a vineyard row
class_prompts.tree: large tree canopy or tree trunk in the background, not grapevine
class_prompts.other_vegetation: trees, shrubs, hedges, bushes, grass, weeds, or other vegetation that is not grapevine
